scope: Scientific Base content activation only. No measurement, scoring, questionnaire, respondent-session, persistence or report-calculation mutation.

governing_positioning.external_science: Published literature, empirical studies, existing research constructs, theoretical models and measurement precedents form the external scientific foundation.
governing_positioning.internal_methodological_evidence: P-120 separately records internal construct-boundary, ownership, redundancy, item-level, information-gain, scope/exposure, safety/privacy, computational-contract and cross-module verification of its own architecture.
governing_positioning.validation_boundary: Internal scientific-methodological, computational and cross-module verification is not empirical psychometric validation on respondent samples.
governing_positioning.system_principle: Independent layers remain separate; cross-layer synthesis is join-after-measurement and does not create an Extended Total or universal compatibility score.
governing_positioning.module_admission_principle: A new module is retained only if it addresses an independent measurement question and has a defensible path to incremental information beyond neighboring layers.
